items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Paul Crawford and Ed Kahn interviewing Naki Parker.

ctx.x: All right, ready to go. This is August 28th, 1963 in the Tulane Jazz Archive. Is that correct? Paul Crawford and Ed Kahn interviewing Naki Parker. Let's start at the beginning and get

where you were from, when you were born, and your real name. John Parker, 1918, August the 8th, Palmer, Texas. And were your parents musically inclined? No, we had a cotton farm out there and a player piano that I was interested in all my life and that's about how I got started.
